item.title: Opposition stages midnight protest against VB G Ram G Bill 2025 outside Parliament
item.description: The political turmoil intensified as soon as the VB-GRAM Bill 2025, related to rural employment, was passed by Parliament. After the bill was passed by voice vote in the Rajya Sabha at midnight, the opposition staged a protest outside the Parliament building.

item.title: Bangladesh erupts after death of Osman Hadi; Violence spreads across Dhaka
item.description: The situation in Bangladesh has spiraled out of control following the death of Sharif Osman Hadi, spokesperson for the Inqilab platform. Violent protests erupted in several cities, including the capital Dhaka, with attacks on newspaper offices and incidents of arson reported.

item.title: AQI crosses 400 in several parts of Delhi amid rising pollution; Health concerns grow
item.description: Air pollution in Delhi-NCR has once again reached critical levels. The average AQI in the capital Delhi remains in the "very poor" category, and in several areas, it has been recorded above 400. Cold weather, fog, and weak winds are contributing to smog conditions, causing eye irritation and breathing difficulties for residents.

item.title: Gold rises for third straight day, Silver rally continues; Check today’s rates here
item.description: Gold and silver prices continue their upward trend. Gold prices have risen for the third consecutive day, with 24-karat gold reaching ₹1,35,000 per 10 grams in Delhi. Silver is also trading strongly at ₹2,11,100 per kilogram.

item.title: Who was Osman Hadi? Death of student leader sparks violence in Bangladesh
item.description: Violence and tension have gripped Bangladesh following the death of Sharif Osman Hadi, a prominent student leader and spokesperson for the Inqilab Manch. Protests, arson, and vandalism have been reported in several cities, including Dhaka.

item.title: ICICI Prudential AMC IPO listing delivers strong gains to investors; Details here
item.description: ICICI Prudential AMC Ltd. shares made a strong debut on the stock market. The company's shares listed on the NSE and BSE at a premium of approximately 20%, giving investors excellent returns on the listing day itself.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi explores Rolls-Royce Phantom in Germany; Video goes viral
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi was seen experiencing a Rolls-Royce Phantom car at the BMW headquarters in Munich during his visit to Germany. A video of him is going viral on social media, showing him closely examining the car's luxury, comfort, and design details.

item.title: Parliament Winter Session: Lok Sabha Adjourned Sine Die; Key Bills Passed
item.description: Today was the last day of Parliament Winter Session, and the Lok Sabha was adjourned indefinitely (sine die). This means that no further sittings will be held during this session.

item.title: Bharti Singh, Haarsh Limbachiyaa welcome second child today; Deets inside
item.description: Popular comedian Bharti Singh and her husband, writer-producer Haarsh Limbachiyaa, have welcomed a second bundle of joy into their family. The couple has been blessed with a baby boy today.
